prompt: Target: 3-methyl-3-pentanol. Shortest route uses Grignard addition to which carbonyl?
explanation: 3-methyl-3-pentanol has three substituents on the C-OH: CH₃, CH₂CH₃, CH₂CH₃. You can disconnect either Me (from 3-pentanone + MeMgBr) or Et (from 2-butanone + EtMgBr) — both are valid one-step routes.
